title: Sign line of f′(x)
back: Mark the critical points, write the sign of $f'$ in each interval: + means increasing, − means decreasing. + to − is a maximum; − to + is a minimum.

title: Open box from a square sheet
back: Cut squares of side $x$: $V=x(a-2x)^2$. Maximum at $x=\dfrac a6$. For an 18 cm sheet: $x=3$ cm, $V=432$ cm³.

title: Related rates
back: Write the formula linking the quantities, differentiate with respect to $t$, then substitute. Decreasing quantities get a minus sign.

title: Increasing or decreasing
back: On an interval. Factorise $f'$, mark its zeros, check the sign in each interval.

title: First derivative test
back: No sign change at $c$: neither, a point of inflexion.

title: Second derivative test
back: Frown = maximum, smile = minimum. $f''(c)=0$: the test fails.

title: Absolute maximum and minimum on [a, b]
back: Largest value = absolute maximum; smallest = absolute minimum. End points must be included.

title: Sphere
back: Needed for balloon, bubble and ice-ball rate questions: $\dfrac{dV}{dt}=4\pi r^2\dfrac{dr}{dt}$.

title: Cone and cylinder
legend: l = slant height, l² = r² + h²
back: Cone CSA $=\pi rl$; cylinder TSA $=2\pi r(r+h)$. In a conical tank, use similar triangles to remove $r$ or $h$ before differentiating.

title: Closed cylinder, given volume, least surface
back: Height equals diameter. Standard 5-mark result: state it only after proving it.

title: Open box from a square sheet of side a
legend: x = side of the square cut from each corner
